# run_CellBarcode.Rmd

This is a cleaned up version of /0/0ddcec61-75f4-4347-b696-e96ec587183c/data/results/YL/PIP-3583/Analysis/CellBarcode_3.22/plate_UMI_constant/run_CellBarcode.v3.Rmd

Version history:

V3: this is based on run_CellBarcode.v2.Rmd.

This version uses plate+wellid UMI and constant + barcode patterns.

Detect and cluster barcodes for whole plate. Results go under ./run2/

filtered clustered bc: first 4 bcs && count>well[bc_clustered.reads]/50

potential bc (final barcodes): count>well[bc_clustered.reads]/50 (or first 4 BCs if num ptential bc < 4 )

V2: this is based on test_CellBarcode.v2.Rmd.

This version uses plate+wellid UMI and constant + barcode patterns.

Detect and cluster barcodes for whole plate. Results go under ./run1/

filter clustered bc using stdr>4 && count>well[bc_clustered.reads]/10

Prepare package for usage

# 1. read samplesheet for sample tags and constants

## 1.1 read samplesheet

```{r}
csvfile <- sprintf('/Users/lany/mount_drives/HPC_Projects/0/0ddcec61-75f4-4347-b696-e96ec587183c/data/results/YL/PIP-3583/Analysis/Barcode_analysis/UMIs.v2/%s.unix.csv',plateid)
df.csv <- read.csv(csvfile, header = T, sep = ',')
df.csv <- df.csv[,-c(1)]
colnames(df.csv) <- c('wellid', 'sample_tag1', 'const1', 'sample_tag2', 'const2')

```

# 2. Run pipeline following similar steps to YL's homebrew pipelines. Check outputs at each step.

## 2.1 aerosal filter to remove reads cov\<2

load single fastq file, remove aerosal contaminant with cov=1;

```{r}
if (plateid!='plate6'){
  fq_files <- file.path(fastq_dir,sprintf('%s_merged.fastq.gz', plateid))
} else {
  fq_files <- file.path(fastq_dir,'plate6fullLIBk562_merged.fastq.gz')
}
barcode_df.raw = read_fastq_gz(fq_files)

# 599,983 uniq reads
print(dim(barcode_df.raw))
# [1] 599983      2
plate_stats[['raw_reads_uniq']] <- dim(barcode_df.raw)[1]
# total input reads: 5,603,546
sum(barcode_df.raw$freq)
# [1] 5603546
plate_stats[['raw_reads']] <- sum(barcode_df.raw$freq)

# remove cov<2: remove 376,906
sum(barcode_df.raw$freq<=1)

# after filtering: 143,625 uniq reads, total 5,226,640 reads.
barcode_df <- barcode_df.raw[barcode_df.raw$freq>1,]
dim(barcode_df)
# [1] 223077      2
plate_stats[['raw_read_cov>1_uniq']] <- dim(barcode_df)[1]
sum(barcode_df$freq)
plate_stats[['raw_read_cov>1']] <- sum(barcode_df$freq)
rm(barcode_df.raw)
```

## 2.2 detect unique reads matching sample_tags, constants and bc pattern backbones.

```{r}
well_stats <- c()
for (csv_row in 1:nrow(df.csv)){
  ### 2.2.1 select a well to analysis
  process_stats <- c()
  # sample_tag1 = "AGACCGTGA"
  # sample_tag2 = "GTAGCACAG" # plate1_A1
  # const1 = 'GGCCTCTTCCGCGTCTTC'
  # const2 = "GGGAGGGGCAAACAACAGA"
  wellid <- df.csv[csv_row,1]
  sample_tag1 <- df.csv[csv_row,2]
  const1 <- toupper(df.csv[csv_row,3])
  sample_tag2 <- df.csv[csv_row,4]
  const2 <- df.csv[csv_row,5]
  sample_tag2.rc <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAString(x=sample_tag2)))
  const2.rc = toupper(as.character(reverseComplement(DNAString(x=const2))))
  # barcode only pattern
  # pattern = "GCTC([ACTG]{3})CAG([ACTG]{3})GTT([ACTG]{3})ACT([ACTG]{3})CTC([ACTG]{3})AGG([ACTG]{3})GAC([ACTG]{3})GAGCGGT"
  pattern.read = paste(sample_tag1,const1,"(.*)GCTC([ACTG]{3})CAG([ACTG]{3})GTT([ACTG]{3})ACT([ACTG]{3})CTC([ACTG]{3})AGG([ACTG]{3})GAC([ACTG]{3})GAGCGGT(.*)",const2.rc,sample_tag2.rc,sep = "")
  process_stats[['wellid']] <- wellid
  
  ### 2.2.2: fwd reads
  matched_reads.fwd <- bc_extract_df(barcode_df, pattern.read, maxLDist = 0)
  
  process_stats[['fwd.match_reads']] <- sum(matched_reads.fwd$count)

  process_stats[['fwd.match_reads_uniq']] <- dim(matched_reads.fwd)[1]


  ### 2.2.3 rev reads
  rc <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(x=barcode_df$seq)))
  barcode_df.rc = barcode_df
  barcode_df.rc$seq= rc
  
  matched_reads.rc <- bc_extract_df(barcode_df.rc, pattern.read, maxLDist = 0)
  # 913 unique reads in well, total 38,039 reads.
  # sum(matched_reads.rc$count)
  # 38039
  process_stats[['rc.match_reads']] <- sum(matched_reads.rc$count)
  
  # dim(matched_reads.rc)
  # [1] 913   2
  process_stats[['rc.match_reads_uniq']] <- dim(matched_reads.rc)[1]

  ### 2.2.4. merge fwd + rc reads
  matched_reads.merged <- merge(matched_reads.fwd, matched_reads.rc, by.x="barcode_seq", by.y="barcode_seq", all.x=T, all.y=T)
  matched_reads.merged$count.x[is.na(matched_reads.merged$count.x)]=0
  matched_reads.merged$count.y[is.na(matched_reads.merged$count.y)]=0
  matched_reads.merged$count.fwdrc <- matched_reads.merged$count.x + matched_reads.merged$count.y
  matched_reads.merged <- matched_reads.merged[order(matched_reads.merged$count.fwdrc, decreasing = T),]
  process_stats[['fwdrc.match_reads']]=sum(matched_reads.merged$count.fwdrc)
  
  # dim(matched_reads.merged)
  # [1] 1215    4
  process_stats[['fwdrc.match_reads_uniq']] = dim(matched_reads.merged)[1]
  # matched_reads.merged[1,]
  #                                                                                                                                                                                       barcode_seq
  #                                                                                                                                                                                            <char>
  # 1: AGACCGTGAGGCCTCTTCCGCGTCTTCGCCTTCGCCCTCAGACGAGTCGGATCTCCCTTTGGGCCGCCTCCCCGCCTTTGCTAGTCTACGCTCTGGCAGTGCGTTAAGACTTTGCTCGTTAGGATGGACTTGGAGCGGTCTGTGCCTTCTAGTTGCCAGCCATCTGTTGTTTGCCCCTCCCCTGTGCTAC
  #    count.x count.y count.fwdrc
  #      <num>   <num>       <num>
  # 1:    9493   10359       19852

  ### 2.2.5 extract exact matching barcodes from merged reads
  # We expect each read contains a valid barcode.

  matched_reads.merged <- matched_reads.merged[,c('barcode_seq', "count.fwdrc")]
  colnames(matched_reads.merged) <- c('seq','freq')
  # input detected reads for barcode detection
  pattern.bc = "GCTC([ACTG]{3})CAG([ACTG]{3})GTT([ACTG]{3})ACT([ACTG]{3})CTC([ACTG]{3})AGG([ACTG]{3})GAC([ACTG]{3})GAGCGGT"
  df.bc_backbone <- bc_extract_df(matched_reads.merged, pattern.bc, maxLDist = 0)
    #                                           barcode_seq count
    #                                                <char> <num>
    # 1: GCTCTGGCAGTGCGTTAAGACTTTGCTCGTTAGGATGGACTTGGAGCGGT 21928
    # 2: GCTCCAGCAGCTAGTTTCGACTTCTCTCATAAGGTTAGACAATGAGCGGT 16935
  process_stats[['match_bc.reads']] <- sum(df.bc_backbone$count)
  
  # found 555 barcodes before clustering
  # dim(df.bc_backbone)
  # [1] 555   2
  process_stats[['match_bc.bcs']] <- dim(df.bc_backbone)[1]
  # output reads and counts as csv.
  if (! overwrite){
    if(!dir.exists(sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s', analysis_root,plateid))){
      dir.create(sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s', analysis_root,plateid), recursive = T)
    }
    
    write.csv(df.bc_backbone, 
              file=sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s/%s.bc.csv', analysis_root,plateid,wellid),
              row.names = F)
  }

  ### 2.2.7 cluster similar barcodes together - add read counts of similar barcodes.
  # This one is correct!
  # compute levenshtein distance
  df.ld <- data.frame(lapply(df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq, function(x){stringdist(df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq, x, method = 'lv')} ))
  colnames(df.ld) <- 1:dim(df.bc_backbone)[1]
  # df.ld[1:3,1:3]
  #    1  2  3
  # 1  0 16 13
  # 2 16  0 16
  # 3 13 16  0

  # now merge:

  # the sequences are already in descending order of the count, so it is safe to merge
  bc_cluster.count <- c()
  bc_cluster.bc <- c()
  
  # start with all barcodes, end of each search set count for merged barcode to 0
  df.bc_backbone2 = df.bc_backbone
  for (row in 1:dim(df.ld)[1]){
    current_bc <- df.bc_backbone2$barcode_seq[row]
    if (df.bc_backbone2$count[row]>0){
      idx_to_merge <- which(df.ld[row,]<=1)
      bc_cluster.count <- c(bc_cluster.count, sum(df.bc_backbone2$count[idx_to_merge]))
      bc_cluster.bc <- c(bc_cluster.bc, current_bc)
      df.bc_backbone2$count[idx_to_merge] = 0
    } 
  }
  
  df.bc_clustered <- data.frame(barcode_seq = bc_cluster.bc, count = bc_cluster.count)
  # sum(df.bc_clustered$count)
  df.bc_clustered <- df.bc_clustered[order(df.bc_clustered$count, decreasing = T),]
  # sum(df.bc_clustered$count)
  # [1] 71928
  process_stats[['bc_clustered.reads']] <- sum(df.bc_clustered$count)

  # barcodes after filtering: 372
  # dim(df.bc_clustered)
  # [1] 372   2
  process_stats[['bc_clustered.bc']] <- dim(df.bc_clustered)[1]
  rm(df.bc_backbone2)
  
  # output reads and counts as csv.
  if (! overwrite){
    if(!dir.exists(sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s', analysis_root,plateid))){
      dir.create(sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s', analysis_root,plateid), recursive = T)
    }
    write.csv(df.bc_clustered, 
              file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s/%s.bc.csv', analysis_root,plateid,wellid),
              row.names = F)
  }
  ### 2.2.9 filter barcodes, take first 4 barcodes
  t=4
  bc_threshold = process_stats[['bc_clustered.reads']]/50
  # 7192.8
  
  # fit glm model
  # glm.read_freq <- glm(y~x, data=data.frame(x=1:nrow(df.bc_clustered), y=df.bc_clustered$count), family = "gaussian")
  # stdres <- rstandard(glm.read_freq)
  
  # idx for potential bcs: any with count above threshold
  potential_bc <- which(df.bc_clustered$count>=bc_threshold)
  # take top 4 as barcode 
  if (length(potential_bc)>=t){
    bc_idx <- potential_bc[1:t] 
  } else {
    bc_idx <- potential_bc
  }
  
  # plot stdr4 filtered on read counts
  if (! overwrite){
    p <- ggplot(data=data.frame(read_freq=df.bc_clustered$count, x=1:nrow(df.bc_clustered)), 
                aes(y=read_freq, x=x))+geom_point(alpha=0.5)
    p <- p + geom_point(data=data.frame(read_freq=df.bc_clustered$count[bc_idx], 
                                        x=1:length(bc_idx)),
                        aes(y=read_freq, x=x), color='red') + 
      ggtitle(sprintf('nb_bc: %d', length(bc_idx)))
    
    barcodeplot_dir <- sprintf('%s/bc_filter/plots/%s.stdr4', analysis_root,plateid)
    if(!dir.exists(barcodeplot_dir)){
      dir.create(barcodeplot_dir, recursive = T)
    }
    ggsave(sprintf('%s/%s.Ld_stdr4.pdf', barcodeplot_dir, wellid), 
             p, width = 10, height = 10, units = 'cm')
  }
  # plot filtering to get potential bcs
  if ( overwrite) {
    p <- ggplot(data=data.frame(read_freq=df.bc_clustered$count, x=1:nrow(df.bc_clustered)), 
                aes(y=read_freq, x=x))+geom_point(alpha=0.5)
    p <- p + geom_point(data=data.frame(read_freq=df.bc_clustered$count[potential_bc], 
                                        x=1:length(potential_bc)),
                        aes(y=read_freq, x=x), color='red') + 
      ggtitle(sprintf('nb_bc: %d', length(potential_bc)))
    
    barcodeplot_dir <- sprintf('%s/bc_filter/plots/%s.potential_bc', analysis_root,plateid)
    if(!dir.exists(barcodeplot_dir)){
      dir.create(barcodeplot_dir, recursive = T)
    }
    ggsave(sprintf('%s/%s.Ld_potential_bc.pdf', barcodeplot_dir, wellid), 
             p, width = 10, height = 10, units = 'cm')
  }
  # output filtered bc list
  if (!overwrite){ 
    if(!dir.exists(sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s', analysis_root,plateid))){
      dir.create(sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s', analysis_root,plateid), recursive = T)
    }
    write.table(x=df.bc_clustered[bc_idx,], 
                file = sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s/%s.bc.filtered.csv', analysis_root,plateid,wellid), 
                col.names = T, sep = ',',
                row.names = F, quote = F)
    # output potential bc list
    write.table(x=df.bc_clustered[potential_bc,], 
                file = sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s/%s.bc.potential.csv', analysis_root,plateid,wellid), 
                col.names = T, sep = ',',
                row.names = F, quote = F)
  }
  # update stats
  tmp <- df.bc_clustered[bc_idx,]
  process_stats[['bc_filtered.bc']] <- dim(tmp)[1]
  process_stats[['bc_filtered.reads']] <- sum(tmp$count)
  process_stats[['bc_filtered.seq']] <- tmp$barcode_seq
  process_stats[['bc_filtered.seq_freq']] <- tmp$count
  tmp <- df.bc_clustered[potential_bc,]
  process_stats[['bc_potential.bc']] <- dim(tmp)[1]
  process_stats[['bc_potential.reads']] <- sum(tmp$count)
  process_stats[['bc_potential.seq']] <- tmp$barcode_seq
  process_stats[['bc_potential.seq_freq']] <- tmp$count
  well_stats[[wellid]] <- process_stats
}
```

save stats as Rdata object

```{r}
save(well_stats, plate_stats, 
     file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid))
```
## 2.3 remove wells with matched_reads<10k
```{r}
load(file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid), verbose = T)
wells_to_remove.match_reads <- c()
for (stat in well_stats){
  if (stat[["fwdrc.match_reads"]]<10000){
      wells_to_remove.match_reads <- c(wells_to_remove.match_reads, stat[['wellid']])
  }
}
well_stats <- well_stats[! names(well_stats) %in% wells_to_remove.match_reads]
```
## 2.4 check for within the plate jumping barcode on filtered barcodes
```{r}
df.filtered_bcs <- data.frame(bc=character(0), wellid=character(0))
for (stat in well_stats){
  for (bc in stat[['bc_filtered.seq']]) {
    df.filtered_bcs[nrow(df.filtered_bcs)+1,] <- c(bc, stat[['wellid']])
  }
}

# make df with duplicated barcodes removed
uniq_bcs <- unique(df.filtered_bcs$bc)
df.filtered_bcs.2 <- data.frame(bc=unique(df.filtered_bcs$bc))
df.filtered_bcs.2$in_num_wells <- unlist(lapply(df.filtered_bcs.2$bc, 
                                                FUN=function(x) sum(df.filtered_bcs$bc==x)))
df.filtered_bcs.2$in_wells <- unlist(lapply(df.filtered_bcs.2$bc, 
       FUN=function(x) paste0(df.filtered_bcs$wellid[df.filtered_bcs$bc==x], collapse = ':')))
# output dup barcode csv
write.csv(df.filtered_bcs.2, 
          file=sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s.per_plate_dup_filtered_bc.1.csv', analysis_root,plateid),
          row.names = F)
wells_to_remove.per_plate_dup_filtered_bc <- unique(unlist(lapply(df.filtered_bcs.2$in_wells[df.filtered_bcs.2$in_num_wells>1], 
                                           FUN = function(x) unlist(str_split(x, pattern = ":")))))
# output list of wells
write.table(wells_to_remove.per_plate_dup_filtered_bc, 
          file=sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s.wells_with_dup_filtered_bc.csv', analysis_root,plateid),
          row.names = F, col.names = F)

```

## 2.6 check for between plate jumping barcodes 
### 2.6.1 for filtered barcodes
```{r}
plateid <- "plate1"
# this stores all filtered barcodes across plates
df.filtered_bcs <- data.frame(bc=character(0), wellid=character(0))
for (plateid in c("plate1", "plate2", "plate3", "plate4", "plate5")) {
  load(file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid), verbose = T)
  
  wells_to_remove.dup_filtered_bc <-
    unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s.wells_with_dup_filtered_bc.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  if (file.size(sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid))!=0L){
      wells_to_remove.match_reads <-
      unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  } else {
    wells_to_remove.match_reads <- c()
  }
  # remove within plate dup wells
  well_stats <- well_stats[!(names(well_stats) %in%
                               c(wells_to_remove.dup_filtered_bc,wells_to_remove.match_reads))]

  
  for (stat in well_stats){
    for (bc in stat[['bc_filtered.seq']]) {
      df.filtered_bcs[nrow(df.filtered_bcs)+1,] <- c(bc, stat[['wellid']])
    }
  }
}

# list between plate jumping barcodes
uniq_bcs <- unique(df.filtered_bcs$bc)
df.filtered_bcs.2 <- data.frame(bc=unique(df.filtered_bcs$bc))
df.filtered_bcs.2$in_num_wells <- unlist(lapply(df.filtered_bcs.2$bc, 
                                                FUN=function(x) sum(df.filtered_bcs$bc==x)))
df.filtered_bcs.2$in_wells <- unlist(lapply(df.filtered_bcs.2$bc, 
       FUN=function(x) paste0(df.filtered_bcs$wellid[df.filtered_bcs$bc==x], collapse = ':')))

# output dup barcode csv
write.csv(df.filtered_bcs.2, 
          file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.between_plate_dup_filtered_bc.1.csv', analysis_root),
          row.names = F)

wells_to_remove.between_plate_dup_filtered_bc <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(df.filtered_bcs.2$in_wells[df.filtered_bcs.2$in_num_wells>1], 
                                           FUN = function(x) unlist(str_split(x, pattern = ":"))))))
write.table(wells_to_remove.between_plate_dup_filtered_bc, 
          file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.wells_with_dup_filtered_bc.csv', analysis_root),
          row.names = F, col.names = F)

# output final barcodes after between plate dedup
df.filtered_bcs.2 <- df.filtered_bcs.2[df.filtered_bcs.2$in_num_wells==1,]
df.filtered_bcs.2 <- df.filtered_bcs.2[
  !(df.filtered_bcs.2$in_wells %in% wells_to_remove.between_plate_dup_filtered_bc), ]
df.filtered_bcs.2 <- df.filtered_bcs.2[,-c(2)]
colnames(df.filtered_bcs.2) <- c("bc", "wellid")
write.table(df.filtered_bcs.2, 
          file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.final_bc_filtered.csv', analysis_root),
          sep = ',', row.names = F, col.names = F)

```
### 2.6.2 for potential barcodes
```{r}
plateid <- "plate1"
# this stores all potential barcodes across plates
df.potential_bcs <- data.frame(bc=character(0), wellid=character(0))
for (plateid in c("plate1", "plate2", "plate3", "plate4", "plate5")) {
  load(file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid), verbose = T)
  
  wells_to_remove.dup_potential_bc <-
    unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s.wells_with_dup_potential_bc.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  if (file.size(sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid))!=0L){
      wells_to_remove.match_reads <-
      unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  } else {
    wells_to_remove.match_reads <- c()
  }
  # remove within plate dup wells
  well_stats <- well_stats[!(names(well_stats) %in%
                               c(wells_to_remove.dup_potential_bc,wells_to_remove.match_reads))]

  
  for (stat in well_stats){
    for (bc in stat[['bc_potential.seq']]) {
      df.potential_bcs[nrow(df.potential_bcs)+1,] <- c(bc, stat[['wellid']])
    }
  }
}

# list between plate jumping barcodes
uniq_bcs <- unique(df.potential_bcs$bc)
df.potential_bcs.2 <- data.frame(bc=unique(df.potential_bcs$bc))
df.potential_bcs.2$in_num_wells <- unlist(lapply(df.potential_bcs.2$bc, 
                                                FUN=function(x) sum(df.potential_bcs$bc==x)))
df.potential_bcs.2$in_wells <- unlist(lapply(df.potential_bcs.2$bc, 
       FUN=function(x) paste0(df.potential_bcs$wellid[df.potential_bcs$bc==x], collapse = ':')))

# output dup barcode csv
write.csv(df.potential_bcs.2, 
          file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.between_plate_dup_potential_bc.1.csv', analysis_root),
          row.names = F)

wells_to_remove.between_plate_dup_potential_bc <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(df.potential_bcs.2$in_wells[df.potential_bcs.2$in_num_wells>1], 
                                           FUN = function(x) unlist(str_split(x, pattern = ":"))))))
write.table(wells_to_remove.between_plate_dup_potential_bc, 
          file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.wells_with_dup_potential_bc.csv', analysis_root),
          row.names = F, col.names = F)

# output final barcodes after between plate dedup
df.potential_bcs.2 <- df.potential_bcs.2[df.potential_bcs.2$in_num_wells==1,]
df.potential_bcs.2 <- df.potential_bcs.2[
  !(df.potential_bcs.2$in_wells %in% wells_to_remove.between_plate_dup_potential_bc), ]

df.potential_bcs.2 <- df.potential_bcs.2[,-c(2)]
colnames(df.potential_bcs.2) <- c("bc", "wellid")
write.table(df.potential_bcs.2, 
          file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.final_bc_potential.csv', analysis_root),
          sep = ',', row.names = F, col.names = F)

```
## 3. Make summary and log files:

1. plate level per stage summary, filter at read matching stage, removing any well\<10,000

2. list of barcodes after barcode merging 

3. csv file showing the number of reads and bcs in each well after barcode merging

```{r}
# 1. plate level per stage summary, 
plate_csv <- sprintf('%s/%s.process.csv', analysis_root, plateid)
if (file.exists(plate_csv)){
  file.remove(plate_csv); 
  file.create(plate_csv);
}
fh <- file(plate_csv)

load(file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid), verbose = T)
well_stats <- well_stats[! names(well_stats) %in% wells_to_remove.match_reads]

# write header:
header="merged_reads,uniq,cov>1,cov>1_uniq,type,match_reads,uniq,match_reads.wells,match_reads.remove_wells,match_bc.reads,match_bc.bc,cluster_bc.reads,cluster_bc.bc,filter_bc.reads,filter_bc.bc,dedup_filtered_bc.bc,dedup_filtered_bc.reads,dedup_filter_bc.wells,dedup_potential_bc.bc,dedup_potential_bc.reads,dedup_potential_bc.wells"
# add raw read info
str1 <- sprintf('%d,%d,%d,%d', plate_stats[['raw_reads']],plate_stats[['raw_reads_uniq']],
               plate_stats[['raw_read_cov>1']],plate_stats[['raw_read_cov>1_uniq']] )

# add fwd matched read info
reads <- 0
reads_uniq <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["fwd.match_reads"]]
  reads_uniq <- reads_uniq+stat[["fwd.match_reads_uniq"]]
  
}
str1 <- sprintf('%s,fwd,%d,%d,', str1,reads,reads_uniq)

# add rc matched read info
reads <- 0
reads_uniq <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["rc.match_reads"]]
  reads_uniq <- reads_uniq+stat[["rc.match_reads_uniq"]]
  
}
str2 <- sprintf(',,,,rc,%d,%d,,,,,,,,,',reads,reads_uniq)

# add fwdrc matched read info
reads <- 0
reads_uniq <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["fwdrc.match_reads"]]
  reads_uniq <- reads_uniq+stat[["fwdrc.match_reads_uniq"]]
}
str3 <- sprintf(',,,,fwdrc,%d,%d,,,,,,,,,',reads,reads_uniq)

# add info on removed wells.
if (plateid!="plate6"){
  str1 <- sprintf('%s%d,%s', str1, 96-length(wells_to_remove.match_reads),
                paste(wells_to_remove.match_reads,collapse =  ':'))
} else{
str1 <- sprintf('%s%d,%s', str1, 48-length(wells_to_remove.match_reads),
                paste(wells_to_remove.match_reads,collapse =  ':'))}

# add matched_bc info
# add rc matched read info
reads <- 0
bcs <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["match_bc.reads"]]
  bcs <- bcs+stat[["match_bc.bcs"]]
  
}
str1 <- sprintf('%s,%d,%d',str1,reads,bcs)

# add clustered_bc info
reads <- 0
bcs <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["bc_clustered.reads"]]
  bcs <- bcs+stat[["bc_clustered.bc"]]
  
}
str1 <- sprintf('%s,%d,%d',str1,reads,bcs)

# add merged_bc info
reads <- 0
bcs <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["bc_filtered.reads"]]
  bcs <- bcs+stat[["bc_filtered.bc"]]
  
}
str1 <- sprintf('%s,%d,%d',str1,reads,bcs)

# add within plate dedup barcode info
# remove dup filtered barcodes
well_stats <- well_stats[! names(well_stats) %in% wells_to_remove.per_plate_dup_filtered_bc]
reads <- 0
bcs <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["bc_filtered.reads"]]
  bcs <- bcs+stat[["bc_filtered.bc"]]
}
str1 <- sprintf('%s,%d,%d,%d',str1,bcs,reads,length(well_stats))

# remove dup potential barcodes
well_stats <- well_stats[! names(well_stats) %in% wells_to_remove.per_plate_dup_potential_bc]
reads <- 0
bcs <- 0
for (stat in well_stats){
  reads <- reads+stat[["bc_potential.reads"]]
  bcs <- bcs+stat[["bc_potential.bc"]]
}
str1 <- sprintf('%s,%d,%d,%d',str1,bcs,reads,length(well_stats))

writeLines(c(header,str1,str2,str3), con = fh)
close(fh)
```

```{r}
load(file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid), verbose = T)

  writeLines(str_csv, con = fh)
}
close(fh)
```

## 4. csv file showing between plate barcode dedup output
```{r}
# 1. plate level per stage summary, 
plateid="plate1"
for (plateid in c("plate1", "plate2", "plate3", "plate4", "plate5")) {
  plate_csv <- sprintf('%s/%s.between_plate_dedup.csv', analysis_root, plateid)
  if (file.exists(plate_csv)){
    file.remove(plate_csv); 
    file.create(plate_csv);
  }
  fh <- file(plate_csv)
  
  # wells to remove:
  load(file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid), verbose = T)
  wells_to_remove.dup_filtered_bc <-
    unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s.wells_with_dup_filtered_bc.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  if (file.size(sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid))!=0L){
      wells_to_remove.match_reads <-
      unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  } else {
    wells_to_remove.match_reads <- c()
  }
  between_plate.wells_to_remove.dup_filtered_bc <-
    unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.wells_with_dup_filtered_bc.csv',
                        analysis_root), header = F)))
  # remove within plate dup wells
  well_stats <- well_stats[!(names(well_stats) %in%
                               c(wells_to_remove.dup_filtered_bc,wells_to_remove.match_reads, 
                                 between_plate.wells_to_remove.dup_filtered_bc))]
  
  # write header:
  header="plate,dedup2_filtered_bc.bc,dedup2_filtered_bc.reads,dedup2_filtered_bc.wells,dedup2_potential_bc.bc,dedup2_potential_bc.reads,dedup2_potential_bc.wells,"
  
  # add between plate dedup filtered bc infos
  reads <- 0
  bcs <- 0
  for (stat in well_stats){
    reads <- reads+stat[["bc_filtered.reads"]]
    bcs <- bcs+stat[["bc_filtered.bc"]]
  }
  str1 <- plateid
  str1 <- sprintf('%s,%d,%d,%d',str1,bcs,reads,length(well_stats))
  
  # load potential dup barcodes 
  load(file=sprintf('%s/bc_cluster/%s.well_stats.RData', analysis_root,plateid), verbose = T)
  wells_to_remove.dup_potential_bc <-
    unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_filter/%s.wells_with_dup_potential_bc.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  if (file.size(sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid))!=0L){
      wells_to_remove.match_reads <-
      unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/bc_extract/%s.wells_under_10k.csv',
                        analysis_root, plateid), header = F)))
  } else {
    wells_to_remove.match_reads <- c()
  }
  between_plate.wells_to_remove.dup_potential_bc <-
    unlist(as.list(read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/plate1-5.wells_with_dup_potential_bc.csv',
                        analysis_root), header = F)))
  # remove within and between plate dup wells
  well_stats <- well_stats[!(names(well_stats) %in%
                               c(wells_to_remove.dup_potential_bc,wells_to_remove.match_reads, 
                                 between_plate.wells_to_remove.dup_potential_bc))]
  
  # add between plate dedup potential bc infos
  reads <- 0
  bcs <- 0
  for (stat in well_stats){
    reads <- reads+stat[["bc_potential.reads"]]
    bcs <- bcs+stat[["bc_potential.bc"]]
  }
  str1 <- sprintf('%s,%d,%d,%d',str1,bcs,reads,length(well_stats))
  writeLines(c(header,str1), con = fh)
  close(fh)
}
```
